# Robo Presence: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-06 · code 9f180302db07 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Build a camera robot on wheels with a Raspberry Pi, an Arduino or an old phone, install it with one command, and drive it live from any browser over WebRTC.
**Live:** https://robo-presence.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/robo-presence · **Layout:** JavaScript pages + tools/deploy.py (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/robopresence/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- Edit the **project source in this folder**; GitHub only holds the built output (`tools/deploy.py` builds
  `theme/assets/app.js`/`app.css` from `web/`). Never edit `tools/.anvil-repo`.
- **New page**: `web/pages/<name>.html` with `UI.page('<name>', {title, auth, nav}, mount)`. Shared engines: `web/pages/_*.html`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code/<Module>.py`; call it from a page with `UI.api('name', {...})`.
- **New table/column**: `TABLES` in `tools/sync_to_anvil.py` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert after deploy).
- **Header, footer, tab bar**: `web/app.js`. Shared helpers: `web/core.js` (`window.UI`). Tokens + components: `web/core.css`.
- **Check**: `python -I tools/check.py --ui` → ALL CHECKS PASSED. Look: `tools/preview/devserver.py` + `tools/preview/shots.py`.
- **Deploy**: `python tools/deploy.py` (dry run), then `python tools/deploy.py --push "Message"`.
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py robopresence` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`tools/sync_to_anvil.py` TABLES)

- **users**: display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData, Sharing
- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **robots**: owner→users, name:str, color:str, notes:str, preset:str, config:obj, config_rev:num, manifest:obj, info:obj, telemetry:obj, last_seen:dt, wanted_until:dt, token_hash:str, tab_token_hash:str, install_code:str, install_code_expires:dt, paired_at:dt, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, BotApi, DemoData, Robots
- **shares**: robot→robots, email:str, user→users, role:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Robots, Sharing
- **passes**: robot→robots, token_hash:str, label:str, role:str, expires:dt, created:dt, last_used:dt, uses:num, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Robots, Sharing
- **sessions**: robot→robots, user→users, guest_pass→passes, pilot_name:str, role:str, secret_hash:str, offer:str, answer:str, state:str, created:dt, answered_at:dt, ended_at:dt, stats:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, BotApi, DemoData, Drive, Robots, Sharing
- **events**: robot→robots, kind:str, text:str, at:dt, is_demo:bool · used in BotApi, DemoData, Robots

## Tools

- `tools/check.py`: Checks before deploying. Run from anywhere:
- `tools/deploy.py`: Deploy the project to Anvil through its GitHub repo (REPO in tools/sync_to_anvil.py).
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/sync_to_anvil.py`: Write this project into the Anvil app's git checkout (the repo Anvil syncs with GitHub).
